title: Forbid Kaspi Nike black long-sleeve offer-card family from any sellable surface

scope.description: Applies to UNIVERSAL, STORE-B, and any future store controlled by this operating system.

reason: This Kaspi card family is a Nike black long sleeve, not the Nike black t-shirt or sleeveless version we sell. Public card evidence says Комплектация=лонгслив. It was mistakenly mapped into the sales identity CL_NEW-CLO_MEN_NIKE-SHIRT_BLACK and must not be treated as sellable.

history.event: Prior live-removal incident documented the wrong-offer long-sleeve family and blocked future existing-card uploads.
Owner manually removed this offer-card family from live Kaspi sale after a second occurrence.

attribution_note.active_flag_policy: Rows remain active_flag=1 solely for historical order/sales attribution because 9 sales_fact_v2 rows reference these offer names.
attribution_note.sellability_policy: These mapping rows must never be treated as a sellable or enable surface and must never be extended with new rows for this Kaspi card family.

reactivation_policy.override_requires: Only a new explicit owner decision file in config/owner_decisions/ may override this registry. The override must name this decision_id, kaspi_family, exact product codes, exact store scope, and intended sellable surface.
reactivation_policy.default_without_override: Do not enable, sell, reactivate, upload, patch, onboard, or extend this Kaspi card family.

web_automation.denylist_surface: Kaspi offer upload, existing-card upload, and pricelist safe-active-patch preflight

enforcement_pointers.autonomous_business: Preserve the historical attribution mapping only; do not use these rows as sellable, enable, upload, patch, or new-row onboarding authority.
